polity.canonical_name_en: Provisional Military Government of Socialist Ethiopia

activity.notes: Mengistu became chairman of the Derg and head of state on 3 February 1977. This military-government phase ended with the establishment of the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia in September 1987.

sources.title: Human Rights Watch — Evil Days: 30 Years of War and Famine in Ethiopia
sources.citation_text: HRW documents the Mengistu government and the Derg era culminating in 1991.

sources.title: Ethiopia state chronology — World Statesmen
sources.citation_text: The chronology records Mengistu as chairman of the Provisional Military Administrative Council from 3 February 1977 to 10 September 1987.
